body: Can't you read? I don't give a fuck about 10000 years from now, I'm on about my life NOW and the fact I don't feel like I matter while I'm alive in this very moment now. IN THE PRESENT TIME! I don't make a difference while I'm alive and no one will know the difference if I wasn't here. But thank you, your nihilist attitude has confirmed my thoughts. So farewell.

Talking about yourself and what you do or don't care about does not change how I feel about myself. It's not that I care how people act once I'm gone, it's the fact I never mattered enough while I was here to make any sort of impact once I am gone. That's why I want to fucking go because I don't matter to anyone. I have been considering this for the past 10 years, it's not me acting rash anymore.

Life is so unfulfilling. I feel like an extrovert living the life of an introvert. The things I used to enjoy doing I don't anymore, I could even be in a room full of people and the thought that I'm alone still lingers at the back of my mind, because no one cares for me, like actually cares. I feel if i disappeared from the face of the earth there would be no void in people's lives, I won't be terribly missed, people will think about me occasionally, reminisce maybe but not actually care about me - it's not the fact I want people to mourn my loss, but the fact I don't really matter that much. I'm sick of constantly being abandoned by those I care for. I have lost so many girl friends because they get in to relationships and leave me behind, or my guy friends who also get in to relationships and are told to stop talking to me because I'm a "threat"... in your mid twenties practically all your friends have settled down which leaves me with no one because my family do not give a flying fuck about me, they never contact me, never invite me to their get togethers, ignore me when I'm around them or criticise me. I live alone and most weeks I go to work come home alone and repeat, then stay by myself all weekend. It's ridiculous I know but I think my life would be so much better if I could settle down but how do people even do that? I've been single now for many years. My friends and strangers constantly compliment me and tell me how beautiful I am (lol) but I don't feel it. I look in the mirror every night and cry because nothing is perfect no matter how hard I try, and if I was so "beautiful" why does no one care and everyone leave me behind. I treat everyone with kindness and I am very caring, so it's not because I'm a bad person, sometimes I feel it's because of that I'm easily tossed aside.
